# API Status Page Template — Companion Resources

Companion files for the [API Status Page Template](https://stackpractices.com/docs/api-status-page-template/).

| File | What it is |
|------|------------|
| `status-page.html` | Status page layout: per-service status, uptime grid, incident history, maintenance |
| `incident-update-template.md` | Initial incident post (severity, affected services, next update) |
| `post-incident-summary-template.md` | Post-incident summary (duration, root cause, action items, postmortem link) |
